purpose: Outcome-blind adaptation of all 18 reviewer lenses to code-relevance decisions within the installed model's input limits.

authoring_blindness.statement: The author was not given and did not read benchmark cases, labels, captures, results, model predictions, or other agents' work. Adaptation used only the frozen catalog, frozen reviewer prompt, the three identified original role bodies, and tokenizer/serializer source.
authoring_blindness.iterations: Token-count and serializer validation only; no output-guided tuning.

decision_contract.binary_question: Does this hunk satisfy the reviewer's TRIGGER WHEN?
decision_contract.choice_question: Which reviewer's TRIGGER WHEN is best satisfied by this hunk?
decision_contract.question_scope: Code relevance, not permission to dispatch or execute a reviewer. Prerequisite recovery and mandatory selection rules remain coordinator responsibilities.

original.true: spawned by the abstraction-architect audit method (references/audit.md, run by /daodan:check-health) or by the reviews of /daodan:review-changes and /daodan:review-branch; asking who canonically owns a fact/policy/state or whether new code duplicates existing logic.
original.false: implementation, security (use senior-review:security-auditor), distributed flows (use senior-review:distributed-flow-auditor), dead code (use senior-review:cleanup-auditor), or cycles/cohesion (use senior-review:code-auditor).

adapted.true: Duplicated domain concepts or logic, competing sources of truth, wrong abstractions, or unclear canonical ownership of facts, policies or state.
adapted.false: Implementation, security, distributed flows, dead code, or dependency cycles and cohesion, without duplicated domain concepts or competing ownership.

reviewers.choice_description: Duplicate domain logic or competing sources of truth; excludes dead code, security, and dependency cycles.
reviewers.rationale: Replace dispatch instructions with the role's structural-entropy remit; remove owner names and qualify exclusions to preserve overlapping relevant lenses.

policy_adaptation.meaning_change: No additional prompt-policy rule is introduced. Changed criteria re-express the original remit for code relevance; missing negatives are authored, not extracted.
